	is_triggered_only = yes

		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_iid value <= 32 } }

				limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_iid value <= 16 } }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_iid value <= 8 } }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_iid value <= 4 } }
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_iid value <= 2 } }
							if = {
								limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_iid value <= 1 } }
								if = {
									limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_iid value = 1 } }
									gsm_default = { VAR = gsm_h1 VALUE = 0 }
									gsm_default = { VAR = gsm_cb1 VALUE = 0 }

									change_variable = { which = gsm_cb1 value = gsm_t_dcb }
									gsm_clamp_min = { VAR = gsm_h1 MIN = 0 }
									gsm_clamp = { VAR = gsm_cb1 MIN = 0 MAX = @gsm_total_cap }

										limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_h1 value < 0.001 } }

country_event = {
	id = gsm_wrap.12
	hide_window = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	immediate = {
		event_target:gsm_t_w12 = {
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_s value <= 100 } }
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_s value <= 50 } }
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_s value <= 25 } }
						if = {
							limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_s value <= 13 } }
							if = {
								limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_s value <= 7 } }
								if = {
									limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_s value <= 4 } }
									if = {
										limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_s value <= 2 } }
										if = {
											limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_s value <= 1 } }
											if = {
												limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_s value = 1 } }
												if = {
													limit = { is_variable_set = gsm_p1_k }
													clear_variable = gsm_p1_k
													clear_variable = gsm_p1_g
													clear_variable = gsm_p1_age
